Hook.Purpose: Smoke-grep for likely global `fetch(` in server load files (manual review of matches).
Hook.Command: find src/routes -type f \( -name '+page.server.ts' -o -name '+layout.server.ts' \) -print0 | xargs -0 grep -nE '(^|[^.])fetch\(' || true
Hook.Expected: For each match: confirm it is the SDK-provided `fetch` destructured from the load event, not the global `fetch`.
